$comment: Single source of truth for the live-only `Program` grouping field. Edit here, then run scripts/assign_program.py --write. Labels are what is stored on rows; `aliases` let you rename a program (old label -> new) and the script migrates rows. Rules are Python/JS-compatible regexes tested case-insensitively against Purpose; first match in `rule_order` wins. Anything unmatched is stored as `unassigned_label` and listed by the script so you can add a rule or a new program. 2026-09-15: added the Cal/OSHA subject-family set for 8 CCR Title 8, routed by citation_rules rather than Purpose regexes so a family is anchored to the regulation rather than to wording. Registry with scope, citation basis, source URL, owner and verification date lives in RegIntel_Work 06_Reviews/Applied/CA__Administrative__CA-RR__Title-08__Baseline-20260902/cal-osha-program-registry.json. Boundary placements (3340/3341 -> HazCom, 5157/5158 -> HazMat, 3205 -> BBP) signed off by Dalton Scott 2026-09-15. 2026-09-16: added Licensed Profession Curriculum & Program Approval (care-setting last-match) and widened the Role-lane renewal/specialty/initial regexes for 16 CCR Title 16. Topic families still win when Purpose names a clinical subject; the new program only takes leftover board-approved curricula.

citation_rules.$comment: Cal/OSHA subject family 4/13 - NEW family; 560 rows that had no home
Cal/OSHA subject family 5/13 - MUST precede family 10
Cal/OSHA subject family 6/13 - the (?![0-9.]) lookahead lets 5144-APPENDIX-A/C/D match while 5144.x would not
Cal/OSHA subject family 9/13 - MUST precede family 10 (5192)
Cal/OSHA subject family 10/13 - broad 519x/520x/521x range, which is why families 5 and 9 precede it
Cal/OSHA subject family 12/13 - 5006.1 precedes 5006 so the dotted section is not shadowed

Cal/OSHA subject family 13/13 - routes 8 CCR 3400 to the EXISTING 'CPR, First Aid & AED' program (PROGRAM tab row 21). No new program is created: a separate 'First Aid, CPR & AED' would differ from it only in word order, which is the vocabulary drift the taxonomy exists to prevent, and with 1 obligation it would also fail the size-discipline gate.
